svg.title: A leave calendar, beside the sprint it affects — SoftTrack web design mockup (#251)
svg.desc: Approved leave is only useful to a team if the team can see it when it plans. The team calendar gets a row per person with who is away and the public holidays of its members, the sprint says how many people are away and for how many working days, and everybody but the manager and HR sees only that somebody is away.
svg.text: A leave calendar, beside the sprint it affects
· who is here for these two weeks
Who is here for these two weeks

g.text: Engineering → Calendar → People, signed in as Amina
3 people are away during this sprint
, 5 working days in all, and one public holiday.

svg.text: What is shown, and to whom
Anyone on a team she is on
Somebody on no team of hers

g.text: with a token that can be rotated
A FEED FOR THE CALENDAR PEOPLE ALREADY LOOK AT
The feed says who is away and until when, and nothing else.
Rotating the token retires the old address.

svg.text: Done when the team calendar shows who is away and its members’ public holidays, the sprint header says how many people are away and for how many working days and feeds
capacity, a manager sees their reports across teams, a viewer sees people on teams they share and their own reports, the type and the note stay with the person, their manager
and HR, pending requests show to the manager and HR, and each team has an .ics feed with a token that can be rotated.
